comparator_features.summary: Normalized local concept for web-operation-job-lifecycle. Validated observations: Job terminal metadata leaves cancellation and denial unexplained: WebOperationJob requires finished_at_utc for completed, failed, cancelled, and timeout, but requires failure_reason_code only for failed and timeout; denied has neither conditional requirement, and the reason code has no minimum length. | Web job lifecycle is a vocabulary, not a state machine: The job schema enumerates statuses but defines no allowed transitions, timestamp ordering, concurrency token, or coupling between status and the independent cancelled boolean. | Cache policy does not enforce privacy or lifecycle decisions: CachePolicy has no required fields or conditional invariants connecting store, max_age_seconds, cache_key_ref, and redaction_profile_id. | Payload success can contradict embedded job status: The required payload success boolean and optional embedded job status have no consistency rule, and there is no revision or concurrency field to adjudicate competing result and job updates. | Failed and denied calls may be explanation-free: denial_reason_code, error_code, error_message, warnings, and job are optional and no conditional requires any of them when success is false or a job is denied, failed, cancelled, or timed out.
comparator_features.title: Web Operation Job Lifecycle

Validated observations: Search and traversal success need no result artifact: The schema defines success-specific result requirements for read, extract, and research only; search, crawl, and map have no corresponding success oracle or required output reference. | Automated invocation reason is conditionally required: InvocationProvenance requires agent_reason whenever invocation_source is agent_initiated, goal, prd, planning_wizard, or subagent. | Successful evidence-bearing operations can carry empty evidence: Success conditionals require evidence-property presence for read, extract, and research, but read_receipt_refs and citation_refs have no minItems and content, source, answer, and run evidence references are not consistently constrained nonempty. | Traversal can be unbounded and policy-ambiguous: WebTraversalInput requires only operation, tool, and root_url; max_pages, max_depth, same_origin_only, include/exclude paths, respect_robots, and dedup are optional, with no maximum page or depth bound and no URI-format constraint. | Research execution mode and scale are underconstrained: WebResearchInput requires only web_operation, tool_id, and task; research_mode, depth_hint, max_sources, auto_read_cap, autonomous, starting_urls, and schema behavior remain optional, while numeric maxima are absent.
